column3: “Evil” is rendered “wicked,” and NASB adds “so He.”
“All the sons of Judah were five” is rendered “Judah had five sons in all.”
The Hebrew reads “Dara” (1 Kgs 4:31 has “Darda”), as NASB does.
“The sons of Carmi” is rendered “the son of Carmi”; “acted unfaithfully in the devoted things” is rendered “violated the ban.”
“The sons of Ethan” is rendered “the son of Ethan.”
“Descendants of Judah” is rendered “sons of Judah.”
The Hebrew is difficult (“fathered with Azubah a wife, and with Jerioth”); NASB renders “had sons by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Havvoth-jair” is rendered “the towns of Jair,” and “daughters” as “villages.”
NASB keeps “Caleb-ephrathah” as a place; the Hebrew may be read differently. The meaning is uncertain.
